findings.problem: The hint "ein ___" also allows "wenig", since "ein wenig" is common, correct German for a bit or a little.
findings.fix: hint: after ein: ein ___ (the everyday word, not wenig)

findings.problem: In Austria people commonly say "ein bissl" (often "a bissl") instead, and in Switzerland "es bitzeli", so regional should not be null.
findings.fix: regional: { where: "Austria", text: "In everyday speech Austrians usually say ein bissl (often a bissl)." }

back.target: a bit, a little (in ein bisschen; literally a little bite)

note: The trick works well because bisschen really does come from Biss (bite) plus -chen, so it literally means a little bite.
